questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: She said that she [finish] her homework before dinner.
Select the correct reported speech form: 'I am sure that he will come,' she said.
options: She said that she was sure that he would come.
She said that she was sure that he will come.
She said that she was sure that he had come.
She said that she was sure that he was coming.
questions.answer: She said that she was sure that he would come.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the passive voice? Choose the option that shows the passive form of the verb.
options: The book was written by a famous author.
The book wrote by a famous author.
The book is written by a famous author.
The book writes by a famous author.
questions.answer: The book was written by a famous author.

questions.question: Complete the sentence with the correct type of conditional: If I _______ more time, I would learn to play the piano.
Choose the best collocation: She gave a speech that was well received by the audience. The word that best completes the sentence is...
Select the correct dependent preposition: I'll call you _______ I arrive.
Which of these sentences uses a discourse marker appropriately to introduce a new idea?
options: However, I think we should reconsider the options.
Therefore, I think we should reconsider the options.
Nevertheless, I think we should reconsider the options.
Moreover, I think we should reconsider the options.
questions.answer: Therefore, I think we should reconsider the options.

questions.question: Choose the correct word to complete the phrase: 'It's raining cats and _____.'
Select the correct form of the adjective to complete the sentence: The film was so _______ that I couldn't stop watching it.
Which sentence correctly uses the present perfect continuous tense?
options: I have been studying English for five years.
I was studying English for five years.
I had studied English for five years.
I will study English for five years.
questions.answer: I have been studying English for five years.
